lines.adventure.elder.1: Rabites overran the Mossy Ruins across the river. Press {key:attack} to swing your sword and clear them out!
lines.adventure.elder.2: Clear the ruins and the old chest opens. The Mana crystal sleeps in the shrine behind the great door.
lines.adventure.lise.1: A rabite got into my garden again! Could you shoo it away?
lines.adventure.lise.2: Mind the bats in the ruins. They swoop when you get close!
lines.adventure.pip.1: Hi! The bridge leads to the Mossy Ruins.
lines.adventure.pip.2: Keep {key:attack} held after a swing, then let go: a SPIN ATTACK!
lines.adventure.hero.key: I got the SHRINE KEY! Now the great door in the ruins will open.
lines.adventure.setting.camera.help: Rooms: screen by screen, as Zelda. Scroll: it follows the hero
lines.adventure.setting.light.help: GPU: pools of light and shadows (slow on a phone). Fast: smooth on a phone. Auto: GPU on a computer, Fast on a phone

brief: The adventure slice: a top-down action adventure in the manner of Secret of Mana and Zelda, bright and cheerful. A young swordsman, called only HERO (a man), walks from Mana Village across the river into the Mossy Ruins and the Shrine of Mana; the villagers (the old elder, Lise the florist, Pip a village boy) talk to him in a friendly, plain way. Rabites are small rabbit-like monsters (from Secret of Mana); Mana is the world's magic. Lines in the dialog box are typed out a letter at a time.
